sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative food photograph for a Russian home cooking recipe catalog. Photorealistic editorial food photo, landscape 3:2, ordinary homemade salad clearly visible in one simple light ceramic serving bowl or plate. 45 degree overhead angle, light neutral linen or stone tabletop, soft daylight, realistic ingredients and natural colors. Comfortable margins, important food stays inside central 80 percent for responsive cropping. No people, hands, utensils, text, logos, packaging, watermarks or decorative props. No extra toppings, dressings or side dishes unless explicitly named in Subject. Actual food is the main subject, not an atmospheric scene.
